name: tool-riazm4777-inbox-executa-dnsb9fqu
description: Anna Inbox Executa for Gmail sync, thread actions, drafts, attachments, Brief workflows, Ask, and Anna LLM sampling.
author: Panwb

credentials.name: GMAIL_ACCESS_TOKEN
credentials.description: Optional Google OAuth access token. Local token files are used when platform injection is unavailable.

credentials.name: GOOGLE_ACCESS_TOKEN
credentials.description: Alternative Google OAuth access token name supported by Anna platform credential mapping.

credentials.name: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
credentials.description: DashScope API key for direct LLM access. Required when ai_provider is set to dashscope.

credentials.name: DASHSCOPE_MODEL
credentials.description: DashScope model name (e.g. qwen3-max). Defaults to qwen3-max if not set.

credentials.name: GMAIL_MULTI_TOKENS
credentials.description: JSON array of {email, access_token, refresh_token, client_id, client_secret, expires_at} for additional mailboxes. Leave empty for single-mailbox mode.

tools.name: check_google_oauth

parameters.description: User message to send to DashScope.

tools.description: Ask the configured DashScope model. This is a direct DashScope wiring test.

parameters.description: User message to send to DashScope.

parameters.name: model_preference

parameters.name: model_preference

tools.description: List compact Gmail inbox messages from a recent day window without running Brief or an LLM.

parameters.description: Inbox category: inbox, todos, starred, snoozed, done, drafts, sent, trash, spam, or all.

tools.name: get_cached_email
tools.description: Read one bounded Gmail text body by id, fetching and caching it when the body is not cached yet.

tools.name: resolve_contact_avatars
tools.description: Resolve saved Google Contact avatar URLs for email addresses. Returns permission_required when Contacts scope is unavailable.

tools.name: check_gmail_auth
tools.description: Check whether Gmail authorization is available. Platform: checks for injected OAuth token. Local: checks for token file existence (does not validate expiry).

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Strategy mode: auto, default_secretary, creator_opportunity, security_billing

parameters.description: How many recent Primary emails to fetch first.

tools.description: Poll a background mail-agent run by run id.

tools.name: get_active_cards
tools.description: Get all active attention cards for a mailbox from persistent storage.

tools.name: get_cleanup_bundle_page
tools.description: Get one page of cleanup bundle messages without refreshing active cards.

tools.name: list_mailboxes
tools.description: Discover and list registered mailboxes, including selected and authorization state.

tools.description: List one transient compact Gmail page without writing message summaries to the local cache.

parameters.description: Maximum messages to return, from 1 to 100.

parameters.description: Offset within the current Gmail page after response byte limiting.

tools.description: Remove a mailbox from the registry without deleting its stored data.

tools.description: Get the current scan plan configuration for a mailbox (schedule, time range, priorities, etc.).

tools.name: set_scan_plan
tools.description: Save or update the scan plan for a mailbox.

tools.name: get_card_detail
tools.description: Get a single card's detail including thread context. Set include_body=true only when the user explicitly asks to view the original email body.

parameters.description: Whether to include the original email body for user display.

tools.name: get_thread_context_page
tools.description: Load one bounded page of earlier thread-context messages for a card.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum messages to return in this page. Defaults to 5 and is capped by the Executa.

tools.name: get_inbox_thread_page
tools.description: Get one page of an Inbox Gmail thread with bounded display bodies and attachment metadata.

parameters.description: Message initially opened from the Inbox list.

parameters.description: Exclusive thread index boundary for older-page pagination.

parameters.name: include_display_body
parameters.description: Whether to include bounded display HTML/text for each message.

tools.name: get_inbox_message_display_body
tools.description: Get the full display body for one Inbox message when the thread page returned a truncated body.

tools.description: Prepare short-lived preview or download access for an Inbox attachment.

parameters.name: attachment_id
parameters.description: Opaque attachment token from Inbox thread DTO.

tools.name: prepare_attachment_download
tools.description: Prepare a short-lived download URL for a Gmail attachment behind a card.

tools.description: Ask Anna to summarize a thread behind a card.

tools.description: Ask Anna to draft a reply for a card's thread.

tools.name: revise_draft
tools.description: Ask Anna to revise a draft reply based on user feedback.

parameters.name: anchor_message_id

tools.name: start_inbox_mail_prompt
tools.description: Start a mail-context AI prompt from the left Anna sidebar and optionally return a draft-reply artifact.

parameters.description: Message initially opened from the Inbox list.

parameters.name: visible_prompt
parameters.description: Prompt visible in the left Anna sidebar.

parameters.name: expected_artifact
